answer.sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoiceid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoicedate) AS yr
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices
  WHERE invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01'
    AND invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
),
rev AS (
  SELECT inv.yr, SUM(il.extendedprice - il.taxamount) AS revenue_before_tax
  FROM inv
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il ON il.invoiceid = inv.invoiceid
  GROUP BY inv.yr
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2015 THEN revenue_before_tax END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN revenue_before_tax END))
  * 100.0
  / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN revenue_before_tax END), 0),
  1
) AS growth_pct
FROM rev
LIMIT 501
